name: dfp
description: Run scripts for the DFP backend (FastAPI) + frontend (Next.js).

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names BE,RL,FE --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run rl" "npm run frontend"
scripts.test:frontend: npm --prefix web-app run lint && npx --prefix web-app tsc --noEmit -p web-app/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
